(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken bun_bot bun_top - item

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
  )

  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)))

              (at start (not (grill_free)))

    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))

  )

  (:durative-action stack_chicken
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken)) (at start (grilled chicken)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken))) (at end (stacked chicken)))

stage_records.domain_pddl:
(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    mushroom12 sausage12 plantain12 nugget12 parsnip12 carrot12 celery12 peas12 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

  (:durative-action grill_sausage12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw sausage12)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw sausage12)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled sausage12))
              (at end (stackable sausage12))
              (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action grill_mushroom12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated mushroom12)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (marinated mushroom12)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled mushroom12))
              (at end (stackable mushroom12))
              (at end (grill_free))))

  (:durative-action fry_nugget12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw nugget12)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw nugget12)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried nugget12))
              (at end (stackable nugget12))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action fry_plantain12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut plantain12)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut plantain12)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried plantain12))
              (at end (stackable plantain12))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))))

  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))

  (:durative-action stack_mushroom12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable mushroom12)) (at start (grilled mushroom12)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable mushroom12))) (at end (stacked mushroom12))))

  (:durative-action stack_carrot12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable carrot12)) (at start (cut carrot12)) (at start (stacked mushroom12)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable carrot12))) (at end (stacked carrot12))))

  (:durative-action stack_sausage12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable sausage12)) (at start (grilled sausage12)) (at start (stacked carrot12)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable sausage12))) (at end (stacked sausage12))))

  (:durative-action stack_celery12
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable celery12)) (at start (cut celery12)) (at start (stacked sausage12)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable celery12))) (at end (stacked celery12))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked celery12)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken13 patty13 potato13 fish13 yam13 lettuce13 cucumber13 stock13 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  ;; grill patty13: raw -> grilled, uses grill
  (:durative-action grill_patty13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw patty13)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw patty13)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled patty13))
              (at end (stackable patty13))
              (at end (grill_free))))

  ;; grill chicken13: requires marinated -> grilled
  (:durative-action grill_chicken13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated chicken13)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (marinated chicken13)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled chicken13))
              (at end (stackable chicken13))
              (at end (grill_free))))

  ;; generic cut: raw -> cut on cutting board
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  ;; fry fish13: raw -> fried
  (:durative-action fry_fish13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw fish13)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw fish13)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried fish13))
              (at end (stackable fish13))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  ;; fry potato13: requires cut -> fried
  (:durative-action fry_potato13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut potato13)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut potato13)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried potato13))
              (at end (stackable potato13))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  ;; boil: raw -> boiled on boiler
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))))

  ;; marinate: cut -> marinated on marinator
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

  ;; mash: boiled -> mashed on cutting board
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))

  (:durative-action stack_chicken13
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken13)) (at start (grilled chicken13)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken13))) (at end (stacked chicken13))))

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable lettuce13))) (at end (stacked lettuce13))))

(define (domain cooking)

    (marinated ?i - item)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    tofu04 potato04 zucchini04 carrot04 celery04 peas04 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    ;; completion and lag predicates for temporal constraints
    (done_grill_tofu04)
    (lag_ready_stack_tofu04)
    (done_mash_potato04)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash_potato04)
    (done_boil_peas04)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil_peas04)
  )

  ;; Generic cut action (raw -> cut) on cutting board
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  ;; Generic boil action (raw -> boiled) on boiler
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))))

  ;; Generic mash action (boiled -> mashed) on cutting board
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (done_mash_potato04)) ))

  ;; Generic fry for items that can be fried from raw; zucchini needs to be cut before frying,
  ;; so we will define an item-specific fry action for zucchini below.
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  ;; Generic marinate (cut -> marinated) on marinator
  ;; tofu requires marination; we will add an item-specific marinate for tofu below
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

  ;; Item-specific grill for tofu04: requires marinated state
  (:durative-action grill_tofu04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated tofu04)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (marinated tofu04)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled tofu04))
              (at end (stackable tofu04))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (done_grill_tofu04))))

  ;; Item-specific marinate for tofu04 (cut -> marinated)
  (:durative-action marinate_tofu04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut tofu04)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut tofu04)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated tofu04))
              (at end (stackable tofu04))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

  ;; Item-specific fry for zucchini04: requires cut
  (:durative-action fry_zucchini04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut zucchini04)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut zucchini04)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried zucchini04))
              (at end (stackable zucchini04))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  ;; Wait action after grill_tofu04 to enforce 3s lag before stacking tofu04
  (:durative-action wait_grill_tofu04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (done_grill_tofu04)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_tofu04))))

  ;; Wait action after mash_potato04 to enforce 3s lag before stacking bun_top
  ;; Note: mash is generic and sets done_mash_potato04; wait uses that.
  (:durative-action wait_mash_potato04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (done_mash_potato04)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash_potato04))))

  ;; Wait action after boil_peas04 to enforce 4s lag before stacking bun_top
  (:durative-action wait_boil_peas04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (done_boil_peas04)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil_peas04))))

  ;; Boil peas04 needs to set done_boil_peas04 at end; use generic boil but add a specific action to set done predicate
  (:durative-action boil_peas04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw peas04)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw peas04)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled peas04))
              (at end (stackable peas04))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (done_boil_peas04))))

  ;; Stack actions in order: stack_bun_bot -> stack_tofu04 -> stack_carrot04 -> stack_celery04 -> stack_bun_top
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)) (at start (ready bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))

  (:durative-action stack_tofu04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tofu04)) (at start (grilled tofu04)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_tofu04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tofu04))) (at end (stacked tofu04))))

  (:durative-action stack_carrot04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable carrot04)) (at start (cut carrot04)) (at start (stacked tofu04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable carrot04))) (at end (stacked carrot04))))

  (:durative-action stack_celery04
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable celery04)) (at start (cut celery04)) (at start (stacked carrot04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable celery04))) (at end (stacked celery04))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (ready bun_top)) (at start (stacked celery04)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash_potato04)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil_peas04)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))
)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    salmon06 turnip06 okra06 tomato06 pepper06 broth06 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    ;; completion and lag predicates for temporal constraints
    (done_grill_salmon06)
    (done_mash_turnip06)
    (done_boil_broth06)
    (lag_ready_stack_salmon06)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)
    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)
  )

  ;; cut: raw -> cut on cutting board
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))))

  ;; marinate: cut -> marinated on marinator
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))))

  ;; item-specific grill for salmon06: requires marinated -> grilled on grill
  (:durative-action grill_salmon06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated salmon06)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (marinated salmon06)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled salmon06))
              (at end (stackable salmon06))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (done_grill_salmon06))))

  ;; item-specific fry for okra06: requires cut -> fried on fryer
  (:durative-action fry_okra06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut okra06)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut okra06)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried okra06))
              (at end (stackable okra06))
              (at end (fryer_free))))

  ;; boil for turnip06: raw -> boiled on boiler (ground action)
  (:durative-action boil_turnip06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw turnip06)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw turnip06)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled turnip06))
              (at end (stackable turnip06))
              (at end (boiler_free))))

  ;; boil for broth06: raw -> boiled on boiler and set completion predicate
  (:durative-action boil_broth06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw broth06)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw broth06)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled broth06))
              (at end (stackable broth06))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (done_boil_broth06))))

  ;; mash for turnip06: boiled -> mashed on cutting board and set completion
  (:durative-action mash_turnip06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled turnip06)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled turnip06)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed turnip06))
              (at end (stackable turnip06))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (done_mash_turnip06))))

  ;; cut-based boil/cut/marinate/etc for other items: tomato06 and pepper06 and salmon06 cut
  ;; Note: generic cut already defined above handles tomato06, pepper06, okra06, salmon06

  ;; stack actions in order — bun_bot -> salmon06 -> tomato06 -> pepper06 -> bun_top
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot))))

  (:durative-action stack_salmon06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable salmon06)) (at start (grilled salmon06)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_salmon06)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable salmon06))) (at end (stacked salmon06))))

  (:durative-action stack_tomato06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable tomato06)) (at start (cut tomato06)) (at start (stacked salmon06)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable tomato06))) (at end (stacked tomato06))))

  (:durative-action stack_pepper06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable pepper06)) (at start (cut pepper06)) (at start (stacked tomato06)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable pepper06))) (at end (stacked pepper06))))

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_top)) (at start (stacked pepper06)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top))))

  ;; wait actions for temporal lags
  (:durative-action wait_grill_salmon06
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 5)
    :condition (and (at start (done_grill_salmon06)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_salmon06))))

    :parameters ()

    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_mash))))

    :parameters ()

    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_from_boil))))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    chicken07 cassava07 plantain07 pickle07 radish07 beans07 bun_bot bun_top - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (done_grill_chicken07)
    (done_mash_cassava07)
    (done_boil_beans07)
    (lag_ready_stack_chicken07)
    (lag_mash_cassava07_bun_top)
    (lag_boil_beans07_bun_top)
  )

  (:durative-action grill_chicken07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw chicken07)) (at start (grill_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw chicken07)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled chicken07))
              (at end (stackable chicken07))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (done_grill_chicken07))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action cut_pickle07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw pickle07)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw pickle07)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut pickle07))
              (at end (stackable pickle07))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action cut_radish07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw radish07)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw radish07)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut radish07))
              (at end (stackable radish07))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action cut_plantain07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw plantain07)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw plantain07)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut plantain07))
              (at end (stackable plantain07))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action fry_plantain07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut plantain07)) (at start (fryer_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut plantain07)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at end (fried plantain07))
              (at end (stackable plantain07))
              (at end (fryer_free))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action boil_beans07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw beans07)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw beans07)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled beans07))
              (at end (stackable beans07))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (done_boil_beans07))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action boil_cassava07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw cassava07)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw cassava07)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled cassava07))
              (at end (stackable cassava07))
              (at end (boiler_free))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action mash_cassava07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled cassava07)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled cassava07)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed cassava07))
              (at end (stackable cassava07))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (done_mash_cassava07))
            )
  )

  ;; Stacking actions in the required order
  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable bun_bot)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_chicken07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable chicken07)) (at start (grilled chicken07)) (at start (stacked bun_bot)) (at start (lag_ready_stack_chicken07)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable chicken07))) (at end (stacked chicken07)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_pickle07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable pickle07)) (at start (cut pickle07)) (at start (stacked chicken07)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable pickle07))) (at end (stacked pickle07)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_radish07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable radish07)) (at start (cut radish07)) (at start (stacked pickle07)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable radish07))) (at end (stacked radish07)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 1)

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_top))) (at end (stacked bun_top)))
  )

    :effect (and (at end (lag_ready_stack_chicken07)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_mash_cassava07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 2)
    :condition (and (at start (done_mash_cassava07)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_mash_cassava07_bun_top)))
  )

  (:durative-action wait_boil_beans07
    :parameters ()
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (done_boil_beans07)))
    :effect (and (at end (lag_boil_beans07_bun_top)))
  )
)

    (lag_ready_stack_bun_top_mash)

      (at start (not (grill_free)))
      (at end (grilled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (grill_free))

    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
      (at start (not (raw ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
      (at end (cut ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (cutting_board_free))

    :effect (and

      (at end (boiled ?i))
      (at end (stackable ?i))
      (at end (boiler_free))

      (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
      (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    tofu08 eggplant08 nugget08 plantain08 parsnip08 carrot08 celery08 peas08 bun_bot bun_top - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot)
  )

  ;; Generic cut action on cutting board
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Marinate requires cut -> marinated on marinator
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Generic boil
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Generic mash: requires boiled
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Item-specific grill for tofu08 (raw -> grilled)
  (:durative-action grill_tofu08
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw tofu08)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw tofu08)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (grilled tofu08))
              (at end (stackable tofu08))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Item-specific grill for eggplant08 (requires marinated)
  (:durative-action grill_eggplant08
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (marinated eggplant08)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (marinated eggplant08)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (grilled eggplant08))
              (at end (stackable eggplant08))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  ;; Item-specific fry for nugget08 (raw -> fried)
  (:durative-action fry_nugget08
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw nugget08)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw nugget08)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (fried nugget08))
              (at end (stackable nugget08))
              (at end (fryer_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut plantain08)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and

              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (fried plantain08))
              (at end (stackable plantain08))
              (at end (fryer_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))
            )
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_bot

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable bun_bot))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked bun_bot)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))

    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable carrot08))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked carrot08)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_eggplant08
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable eggplant08)) (at start (grilled eggplant08)) (at start (stacked carrot08)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable eggplant08))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked eggplant08)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_celery08
    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 1)
    :condition (and (at start (stackable celery08)) (at start (cut celery08)) (at start (stacked eggplant08)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and (at start (not (stackable celery08))) (at start (not (robot_free ?r))) (at end (stacked celery08)) (at end (robot_free ?r)))
  )

  (:durative-action stack_bun_top

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item robot)
  (:constants
    eggplant12 steak12 nugget12 plantain12 parsnip12 carrot12 peas12 - item
    robot1 robot2 - robot
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (toasted ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
    (robot_free ?r - robot))

  ;; Generic grill: raw -> grilled (for items that can be grilled from raw)
  (:durative-action grill
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 10)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (grilled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Generic cut: raw -> cut
  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Generic fry: raw -> fried (for items fryable from raw)
  (:durative-action fry
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (fried ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (fryer_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Generic boil: raw -> boiled
  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Generic marinate: cut -> marinated
  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Generic mash: boiled -> mashed (uses cutting board)
  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?r - robot ?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and

              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Item-specific grill for steak12: requires marinated steak12

    :condition (and (at start (marinated steak12)) (at start (grill_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and

              (at end (grilled steak12))
              (at end (stackable steak12))
              (at end (grill_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Item-specific fry for plantain12: requires cut plantain12

    :parameters (?r - robot)
    :duration (= ?duration 8)
    :condition (and (at start (cut plantain12)) (at start (fryer_free)) (at start (robot_free ?r)))
    :effect (and

              (at start (not (fryer_free)))
              (at start (not (robot_free ?r)))
              (at end (fried plantain12))
              (at end (stackable plantain12))
              (at end (fryer_free))
              (at end (robot_free ?r))))

  ;; Note: No stack actions are required for this task (no stacking goal)
)

(define (domain cooking)
  (:requirements :durative-actions :typing)
  (:types item)
  (:constants
    feast_plate patty20 salmon20 chicken20 tofu20 fish20 falafel20 potato20 onion20 yam20 turnip20 stock20 beans20 lettuce20 tomato20 cucumber20 carrot20 - item
  )

  (:predicates
    (raw ?i - item)
    (grilled ?i - item)
    (cut ?i - item)
    (fried ?i - item)
    (boiled ?i - item)
    (marinated ?i - item)
    (mashed ?i - item)
    (stackable ?i - item)
    (stacked ?i - item)
    (ready ?i - item)
    (grill_free)
    (cutting_board_free)
    (fryer_free)
    (boiler_free)
    (marinator_free)
  )

  (:durative-action cut
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 3)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (cut ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free)) ) )

  (:durative-action marinate
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 6)
    :condition (and (at start (cut ?i)) (at start (marinator_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (cut ?i)))
              (at start (not (marinator_free)))
              (at end (marinated ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (marinator_free)) ) )

  (:durative-action boil
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 12)
    :condition (and (at start (raw ?i)) (at start (boiler_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (raw ?i)))
              (at start (not (boiler_free)))
              (at end (boiled ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (boiler_free)) ) )

  (:durative-action mash
    :parameters (?i - item)
    :duration (= ?duration 4)
    :condition (and (at start (boiled ?i)) (at start (cutting_board_free)))
    :effect (and
              (at start (not (boiled ?i)))
              (at start (not (cutting_board_free)))
              (at end (mashed ?i))
              (at end (stackable ?i))
              (at end (cutting_board_free)) ) )

              (at end (grilled patty20))
              (at end (stackable patty20))
              (at end (grill_free)) ) )

  (:durative-action grill_salmon20

              (at start (not (grill_free)))
              (at end (grilled salmon20))
              (at end (stackable salmon20))
              (at end (grill_free)) ) )
